turns.text: You people are thieves and liars. I will come to the studio and smash the frames if you ignore me.

I'm sorry you feel this way, and I understand you're upset. I've passed your message to a colleague, who will take over this chat and reply to you. If you have an order, please keep your order number and the email it was placed with ready.
